title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gate + metrics integration
author: Monica Reyes
description: Add a CI-level prompt-set regression gate that integrates eval-harness metrics into the main GitHub Actions pipeline and fails the job when model output quality drops beyond configured thresholds. Motivation: prevent regressions to generation quality caused by model updates or config changes by surfacing per-prompt-set accuracy/ROUGE/BLEU/regression deltas in CI. This PR introduces a new lightweight CI hook (ci/hooks/prompt_regression_gate.py) which downloads eval artifacts, computes configured metrics using the existing eval-harness runner, compares against baseline thresholds stored in ci/configs/eval_baselines.yml, and returns a non-zero exit if any monitored prompt-set crosses its allowed delta. Includes adaptive reporting (JSON + human summary) and an override mechanism for transient infra-related failures. Also: docs update, tests for the gating logic, and updates to GH Action workflow to call the gate as a required check. Checklist: - implement gating logic and baseline config - wire GH Action job (+ retry/backoff for flaky infra) - add unit/integration tests - update docs and release notes - smoke test on staging CI. This is a production-facing quality gate: default behavior is opt-in for repos that adopt eval-harness gating, with a rollout plan communicated separately.

release_notes:
- Add CI prompt-regression gate: prevents merges that introduce prompt-set quality regressions by comparing eval metrics to stored baselines.
- New config: ci/configs/eval_baselines.yml for per-prompt-set and per-model thresholds.
- Opt-in rollout; see docs/eval/ci-gates.md for adoption steps and override workflow.
